notes.title: Multiple Train Carriage System
notes.content:
Multiple train carriage system:
    You can now make the train look like the real one using multiple connected carriages!

Improved train model/texture
    It's better than just a bunch of cubes! If you don't like it, you can modify the files quite easily!

notes.title: Added custom models for buildings
notes.content:
- Added custom models for buildings
You can now apply a custom model and texture for buildings!

- Added range selection for decoration tools

notes.title: Added range selection
notes.content:
How to use:
1. Select cursor
2. Select range selection
3. Press left mouse button somewhere
4. Release left mouse button somewhere else
5. Press left control key
6. Press left mouse button to move the area
7. Release left mouse button to duplicate the area

notes.title: Added railroad crossing
notes.content:
There are two ways to build a railroad crossing
1. Build a train track first, and try to build a road on top of it.
2. Build a road first and build a train track on top of it.

Hotkeys for building tiles
Press 1,2,3,4,5 for selecting tile sections.
